Marque o que deseja instalar. Dependênci: Select what to install. Dependencies are selected automatically.
Versions installed in C:\jjphpmy\bin. The active version is the one used by the services.
Nenhum pacote instalado ainda. Use a aba: No packages installed yet. Use the Packages tab.
Adicionar PHP, Node.js, Python e bancos: Add PHP, Node.js, Python and databases to the Windows PATH
Cada pasta dentro do Document Root vira: Each folder inside the Document Root becomes a site. Windows asks for administrator permission to update the hosts file.
O backup salva MySQL, PostgreSQL e Mongo: The backup saves MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB (those running) and the etc\ folder to C:\jjphpmy\backup.
\"Iniciar tudo\" inicia os serviços inst: "Start all" starts the installed services marked as Enabled.
Ao salvar, os arquivos de configuração e: When you save, the configuration files in etc\ are updated with the new ports.
Traga os sites e os bancos de dados do L: Bring sites and databases from Laragon or XAMPP.
Copiar os sites (www do Laragon ou htdoc: Copy the sites (Laragon www or XAMPP htdocs; existing files are not overwritten)
Senha do root no banco de origem: Root password of the source database
A origem só é lida: nada é apagado nem a: The source is only read: nothing is deleted or changed there. Laragon with MySQL 8.4 on both sides: the whole data folder is copied (users and passwords are kept). Different versions or XAMPP (which uses MariaDB): the databases are exported and imported.
Restaura o MySQL e o PostgreSQL do backu: Restores MySQL and PostgreSQL from the chosen backup. The services must be running. Databases in the backup replace current ones with the same name.
Selecione um valor para gerar o QR Code: Choose an amount to generate the PIX QR code.
Sem conexão com a fonte oficial: usando: No connection to the official source: using the saved list.
No connection to the official source: using the fallback list.
Choose the Laragon or XAMPP folder.
Nenhum site ainda. Crie uma pasta dentro: No sites yet. Create a folder inside the Document Root.
O projeto é criado dentro do Document Ro: The project is created inside the Document Root and gets its {name}.test site. Templates use the PHP, Composer and Node.js installed in the Packages tab.
Ao ligar, o JJPHPMY baixa a DLL oficial: When enabled, JJPHPMY downloads the official Xdebug DLL for each PHP. It only debugs when the request asks for it (XDEBUG_TRIGGER), on port 9003: in VS Code, use the PHP Debug extension.
Em cada site você pode escolher a versão: For each site you can choose the PHP version (like cPanel's MultiPHP) and create a temporary public link to show the site to someone else (Cloudflare Tunnel).
Cria um link público temporário (https:/: Creates a temporary public link (https://...trycloudflare.com) for this site
Install PHP in the Packages tab.
WordPress em português, com o banco pron: WordPress in Portuguese, with the database ready
Várias versões do PHP lado a lado: Several PHP versions side by side
PHP por site, como o MultiPHP do cPanel: PHP per site, like cPanel's MultiPHP
Cada pasta em www vira um site nome.test: Each folder in www becomes a name.test site
HTTPS local com certificado próprio: Local HTTPS with its own certificate
Compartilhar site com um link público te: Share a site with a temporary public link
Iniciar, parar e reiniciar pela janela o: Start, stop and restart from the window or the tray
Avisa quem está usando a porta: Tells you who is using the port
Nada fica rodando escondido ao fechar: Nothing keeps running hidden after closing
Arquivos gerados com as portas e pastas: Files generated with your chosen ports and folders
Programas no PATH e Terminal configurado: Programs on the PATH and a ready Terminal
Importa sites e bancos do Laragon e do X: Imports sites and databases from Laragon and XAMPP
